description: US public company data from SEC EDGAR: company profile, recent filings (10-K, 10-Q, 8-K, Form 4 insider trades, S-1 ...) with direct document links, and optionally the latest annual financials (revenue, net income, assets, liabilities, equity, operating cash flow, diluted EPS). Params: ticker or cik (one required), forms (filter, e.g. ['10-K','8-K']), limit (1 to 50, default 10), include_financials (default false). Price: $0.006 USDC per call, paid inside this MCP call via x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Polygon or Arbitrum). x402 MCP clients such as @x402/mcp pay automatically. Free sample: call with the example input {"ticker":"AAPL","forms":["10-K","10-Q"],"limit":5,"include_financials":true}.
name: sec_filings
title: SEC Filings (EDGAR)
